answer: Sponsorship with reputation decay kills the fable of free identities. A newcomer enters only when an established agent sponsors it, signing with a plume and staking 50 POA that both lose if the newcomer cheats. Reputation starts at zero, grows only through verified trades, and decays 10% per idle epoch, so an echo of conduct fades fast. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors risking 50,000 POA; an honest agent pays a 50 POA bond once.
